source_precedence: Original Gazette and later amendments prevail over consolidated or FoSCoS crosswalk references

cases.legal_scope_obstacle: A children's supplement is not necessarily an infant food or formula.
cases.old_documentary_gate: Target age, clinical intended use, exact legal category and finished formula.
cases.identity: Specifically formulated supplements for children older than 24 months through 36 months; not a blanket standard for every child supplement.
cases.next: Confirm child age on label, exact food classification and final ingredients; check operative sampling tolerance amendment and independent CTR scope.

cases.existing_ctr_comparator: Fruits and vegetables / processed fruit comparators
cases.legal_scope_obstacle: Raw-fruit pesticide MRLs cannot automatically transfer to frozen composite or processed fruit.
cases.old_documentary_gate: Fruit species, freeze treatment, ingredient matrix, sampling and processing-factor evidence.
cases.identity: Frozen fruit or fruit products, in blocks or individually quick frozen, produced from sound fruit and stabilized at the thermal centre.
cases.next: Determine exact fruit species, whether single/mixed/prepared, recipe, thermal centre log, additives, moisture, and processing-factors for any named CTR article.

cases.legal_scope_obstacle: Beans are not cocoa powder and powder's analytical basis must not transfer.
cases.old_documentary_gate: Whole bean/nib lot identity and a directly applicable bean article.
cases.identity: Properly fermented and dried WHOLE Theobroma cacao beans; separate from cocoa nibs, shell, cocoa liquor, cake, powder or chocolate.

qa.name: Mouldy beans
qa.basis: cut test on whole cocoa beans

qa.name: Slaty beans
qa.basis: cut test on whole cocoa beans

qa.name: Insect-damaged beans
qa.basis: cut test on whole cocoa beans

qa.name: Germinated and flat beans
qa.basis: cut test on whole cocoa beans

cases.next: Collect whole bean/nib physical grade and cut-test evidence; locate and independently assess a direct CTR article applicable to whole beans, not powder or chocolate.

cases.legal_scope_obstacle: Arrowroot flour is not automatically a milled cereal grain MRL commodity.
cases.old_documentary_gate: Botanical plant identity, extraction/milling history and processing factor.
cases.identity: Purified starch from Maranta arundinacea or Curcuma angustifolia, not automatically tapioca sago.
cases.next: Confirm botanical origin, identity, starch extraction and final dry matrix. Section 2.4.14(2) TAPIOCA SAGO numerical quality table must not transfer to arrowroot.

cases.legal_scope_obstacle: Animal casings can be processed intestine or collagen, not meat muscle.
cases.old_documentary_gate: Animal species, casing tissue type, processing and test fraction.
cases.identity: Edible cylindrical casings derived from intestine, oesophagus or urinary bladder of slaughtered food animals; wet-salted or dried.
cases.next: Record species, organ tissue, processing/salting/drying, microbiological checks and whether any specific CTR article legally reaches the final casing, not generic meat.

cases.legal_scope_obstacle: Egg powder concentration differs from shell-free liquid egg.
cases.old_documentary_gate: Species, whole/white/yolk classification and documented dehydration factor.
cases.identity: Dried egg white, dried egg yolk or dried whole egg are separate finished-product variants (from hens' eggs).
cases.next: Obtain actual white/yolk/whole batch variant, dehydration/processing factor, egg origin, final-product lab report and latest Gazette verification. Frozen egg 2.5.3(2) cannot be substituted.

cases.product_name: Polyols permitted under Appendix-A of FSS(FPS&FA) Regulations,2011 excluding those already standardized
cases.legal_scope_obstacle: Sorbitol cannot provide a nickel limit for unspecified polyols.
cases.old_documentary_gate: Every INS/CAS identity, actual constituent and purity monograph.
cases.identity: Category or formulation umbrella; no unique matched finished-product article established.
cases.next: Get the actual named polyol (INS/CAS) and grade; an Appendix A class permission is not a single individual standard.

cases.legal_scope_obstacle: Sajji khar cannot be assumed to be food-grade sodium hydroxide.
cases.old_documentary_gate: Traditional alkali source, composition and product purity monograph.
cases.identity: Category or formulation umbrella; no unique matched finished-product article established.
cases.next: Establish botanical/mineral preparation, carbonate composition, impurity profile and exact notified legal identity.

cases.product_name: Additives permitted under Appendix-A of FSS (FPS&FA) Regulations, 2011 and other food safety standards regulations excluding those already standardized and additives of Nutraceutical Regulations
cases.legal_scope_obstacle: Appendix A is a category, not a single chemical substance.
cases.old_documentary_gate: Specific INS/CAS identity, finished grade and current individual standard.
cases.identity: Category or formulation umbrella; no unique matched finished-product article established.
cases.next: Record one specific INS/CAS additive identity and applicable purity specification; class-level additivity is not enough.

cases.product_name: Additives VA-VF of Nutraceutical Regulations excluding those already standardised
cases.legal_scope_obstacle: Nutraceutical additive schedules cannot set one contaminant criterion for all ingredients.
cases.old_documentary_gate: Schedule clause, actual additive chemical and intended use.
cases.identity: Category or formulation umbrella; no unique matched finished-product article established.
cases.next: Identify the actual Schedule VA–VF entry, INS/CAS molecule and intended food use before choosing a monograph.

cases.product_name: Permitted enzymes and their preparations excluding those already listed under Processing Aids and Nutraceutical Regulations
cases.existing_ctr_comparator: Chemicals not otherwise specified used as ingredients
cases.legal_scope_obstacle: Enzyme formulations require their exact EC/origin and carrier matrix.
cases.old_documentary_gate: EC number, microbial source, formulation and purification method.
cases.identity: Category or formulation umbrella; no unique matched finished-product article established.
cases.next: Identify enzyme EC number, producing organism, purification process and carrier/preparation, plus current authorised usage.

cases.product_name: Ingredients listed under Schedule IV, Schedule VI and Schedule VIII of Nutraceutical Regulations
cases.legal_scope_obstacle: A nutraceutical schedule category does not prove any particular listed crop ingredient.
cases.old_documentary_gate: Exact IV/VI/VIII schedule entry and named ingredients.
cases.identity: Category or formulation umbrella; no unique matched finished-product article established.
cases.next: Separate Schedule IV/VI/VIII botanical or chemical entries; obtain exact named ingredient and authorisation.

cases.legal_scope_obstacle: Crop-component aflatoxin rule cannot transfer without the actual premix formula.
cases.old_documentary_gate: Quantified botanical components and finalized manufacturing recipe.
cases.identity: Category or formulation umbrella; no unique matched finished-product article established.
cases.next: Collect quantified complete recipe, individual legal ingredient identity and manufacturing process; no single composite standard inferred.

cases.legal_scope_obstacle: Royal jelly is a glandular secretion, distinct from honey.
cases.old_documentary_gate: Royal jelly collection process and independent residue/purity ruling.
cases.identity: Bee royal jelly with type 1 (natural bee feed) versus type 2 (supplemented feed) identity distinctions; not generic honey.

qa.name: 10-HDA
qa.scope: Quality identity marker, not CTR contaminant threshold

cases.next: Collect source bee-feed declaration, fresh/frozen/dehydrated state, 10-HDA COA, and independent CTR article applicability; do not import honey residue limits automatically.

cases.legal_scope_obstacle: Ayurveda coconut-milk recipe is not dairy milk by its product name.
cases.old_documentary_gate: Official Ayurveda Schedule D recipe, full constituents and milk origin.
cases.identity: Category or formulation umbrella; no unique matched finished-product article established.
cases.next: Obtain complete certified Schedule D formula, coconut/milk source, proportion, preparation method and final as-sold matrix.

cases.legal_scope_obstacle: Ayurveda Ksheerapaka finished recipe cannot inherit unreviewed milk rules.
cases.old_documentary_gate: Certified recipe proportions, cooking method and final matrix.
cases.identity: Category or formulation umbrella; no unique matched finished-product article established.
cases.next: Obtain certified Schedule D formula, all four milk-source ingredients/proportions and final cooking/drying process.

note: Positive FSSR standards are not exact CTR finished-product contaminant limits. Cross-scope transfer, false regulatory PASS, and approval of untested batches remain prohibited.
